criteria.test: FE-A1.1-W01-AC01 execution: conversation and result remain legible at ordinary desktop widths
criteria.observation: At 1280, 1440 and 1920 pixels the Agent occupies approximately 30 percent; Q/A and composer remain legible and the Workspace retains the larger share.

criteria.test: FE-A1.1-W01-AC02 execution: normal retained Q/A and draft remain available while navigating the Workspace
criteria.observation: Actual retained managed-model Q/A and a new unsent draft survive native Sources/Overview navigation. Workspace destinations and Inspect belong to the Workspace; one visible chat form occupies the left panel.

criteria.test: FE-A1.1-W01-AC03 execution: opening an actual answer makes its Workspace object the strongest visual element
criteria.observation: Opening the exact retained answer changes the Workspace heading and dominant object while preserving the native return path.

boundary: Live production layout, retained actual managed-model Q/A, navigation, composer, disclosure and Workspace presentation only. No new model invocation, proposal command, native examiner, cycle or overall A1 acceptance is inferred.
